patches_added.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches_added.description: Raises the toolbar from five icons to 12, so Flexboard's hotkeys and text action buttons can fit alongside Gboard's own. How many icons actually show stays yours, set by dragging them in Gboard's toolbar settings.

patches_added.name: Swipe Left to Delete
patches_added.description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's own word-scrub engine, so it behaves exactly like swiping on the backspace key already does — only it can start anywhere.

patches_added.name: Text Action Buttons
patches_added.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists.

patches_removed.name: Swipe to Delete
patches_removed.description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's own word-scrub engine, so it behaves exactly like swiping on the backspace key already does — only it can start anywhere.

patches_removed.name: Toolbar Buttons
patches_removed.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists.

patches_removed.name: Toolbar Native Test
patches_removed.description: Add a 'Test' button to the toolbar through Gboard's own access-point registry so drag reorder and persistence work natively. Writes 'test' at the cursor on tap. Architectural proof-of-concept; off by default.

patches_modified.name: Swipe Right to Undo
patches_modified.description: Swipe right after deleting to put the words back — the swipe starts on the Delete key, or anywhere when Swipe Left to Delete is also applied. Uses Gboard's own undo, which already records what a delete swipe removed.

patches_added.name: Download Facebook Media (573)
patches_added.description: Adds direct downloads for the visible Story, Reel, and video media through MediaStore.

patches_modified.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, and Variations seed fetching.

patches_modified.name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.

patches_modified.name: Brave Origin
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches_modified.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches_modified.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches_modified.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes the Android BatteryStatusManager broadcast listener to prevent continuous OS battery wakeups.

patches_modified.name: Disable Pull To Refresh
patches_modified.description: Completely disables the pull-to-refresh overscroll gesture and animation to prevent accidental page reloads.

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: PNG Asset Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run
patches_modified.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.
